profile.headline: WordPress Developer. Web Developer. Technology Consultant.
profile.summary:
I have over a decade of experience as a tech consultant, providing businesses with IT support, web/app development, and tech infrastructure planning.

My experiences working for an Inc. 5000 company, several boutique studios, and three universities prepared me for the Director of Technology position at the hospitality management company, Kirkendoll Management, overseeing computer and networking equipment, websites, and apps for over a dozen global restaurants and adult entertainment club locations.

With my technology expertise, I can seamlessly integrate into any project or team and execute the right solution.

positions.title: Lead Web Developer
positions.description:
-	Designing and developing custom WordPress websites
-	Developing progressive web apps
-	Developing apps and websites using no-code tools
- Technology consulting
- SEO

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
- Lead full-stack web developer for all website properties
- Developed custom e-commerce WordPress solution
- Developed internal incident management web app
- Developed employee recruitment PHP-based web app
- Provided back-end support for customer-facing mobile apps
- Project management for websites and apps
- Supervised third party remote teams for app development and maintenance, and corporate networks management
- AWS facilitation and administration, including DevOps, Lightsail, EC2 deployment and configuration, RDS, scheduled backups
- Apache/Nginx Administration
- CloudFlare set up and DNS configuration
- Google G Suite Administration
- Maintained website and physical location PCI Compliance
- Inventory management of computer equipment for corporate headquarters, restaurant, and club locations
- Custodian of purchasing and requisitioning computer equipment
- Installed computers, printers, and network equipment
- Interfaced with and maintained outside tech vendor relationships
- Introduced Trello as project management and ticketing system
- Responsible for Google AdWords campaigns
- Motivated Marketo to MailChimp migration and configuration
- Network administrator
- Microsoft AD administrator

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
-	Led the high-priority design and development of Loyno.edu redesign; first mass redesign in over four years
-	Created two custom starter themes to quickly roll out mini-sites using WordPress
-	Developed a social media feed plugin using PHP for Instagram and Twitter Feeds
-	Introduced Git workflow and Sass pre-processing to the team for speedier development 
-	Designed and coded new events calendar system in WordPress
-	Designed and coded a Humans of New York-inspired website utilizing WordPress for student-focused project
-	Developed custom Google Maps plugin to highlight points of interest on a map; scrollable and clickable to show a user a brief description and directions to location
-	Rolled out critical campus-wide promotional mini-sites for students and parents to inform of news and gather information
-	Created password protected WordPress site for internal-use only, gathering data via forms necessary to cut campus spending
-	Setup staging servers on WPEngine and deployed via Git
-	Utilized Advanced Custom Fields to speed-up custom WP development

positions.title: Freelance Web Developer
positions.description:
-	Developed custom WordPress plugin for Wikipedia Contributions
-	Developed a social media feed plugin using PHP for Instagram and Twitter Feeds
-	Developed web app to determine daily earnings needed for a given yearly salary
-	Coded custom Shopify theme using Liquid
-	Designed and wrote custom JavaScript for Squarespace websites: nomadness.tv and thebestfoodinneworleans.com
-	Written tutorials for WordPress fixes, tips and tricks
-	Mobile-first development of websites using Bootstrap

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed custom WordPress sites using Bootstrap from PSD mockups
- Developed custom WordPress plugins and themes for clients
- Custom Craft CMS website development and maintenance
- Joomla and Drupal migrations to WordPress
- Non CMS websites to WordPress migrations
- SEO optimization by devising strategies and deploying tactics
- Taught monthly classes to employees to broaden knowledge of HTML/CSS and WordPress; helped them upsell and to sign clients
- Remote server deployment and security monitoring
- Maintenance of websites running on IIS and Linux Apache/nginx
- Custom PHP and JavaScript to alter site-wide meta data for client sites with limited CMS or FTP access
- Version control using Git

positions.title: 2nd-Tier End User Support Specialist
positions.description:
-	Fixed end-user desktop and network issues for 3,000+ employees and 100+ classrooms, including Law and Medical schools
- Imaging scheduling and deployment
-	In-field and telephone troubleshooting for Mac, Windows XP/7/8, and Linux computers
-	Administered Microsoft Active Directory users & groups, policies, and management concepts
-	Troubleshooting and fixing of printer hardware -- Lexmark, HP, and Canon
-	Installed and configured wireless hubs, routers, switches, and various transmission media, and ensured the proper installation and configuration of workstation hardware and software for efficient operation on the network
-	Configured Ingenico payment systems 
-	Connected with users and defused frustrations while also resolving their technical problems
-	Deployed newly assigned inventory to staff and employees
-	Trained employees on email system migration from Novell GroupWise to Microsoft Exchange/365
-	Obtained certifications: Lenovo, Network+, A+, Microsoft Certified Professional

company.name: Columbia University, School of Social Work

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
- Conducted HIV/STD surveys for drug-involved couples--predominately most of whom were of African-American or Hispanic descent. 

- Data entry and analysis utilizing SPSS software.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Conducted HIV/STD questionnaires for drug-involved couples at shelters, drug addiction/rehabilitation and methadone clinics, as well as walk-ins to our offices.
- Daily use of the SPSS statistics software
- Handled money distribution to patients
- General reception and office duties, including inventory management

positions.title: Tech Services Student Aide Supervisor
positions.description: Did intermediate to advanced level break-fix for computer & printers, as well as supervised fellow student aides who had less experience or were newer to the department.

positions.title: Web Development Student Aide
positions.description:
I was essentially an intern for the Web Development department during the design, coding and implementation of the Hofstra Portal.

I tackled smaller projects that full-timers delegated to me such as coding a Flash-based Hangman game that was featured on the Portal upon launch.

positions.title: Tech Services Student Aide
positions.description: Student computer and printer technician, assisting the full-time techs in software and hardware break-fix.

certifications.name: Microsoft Certified Professional -- Windows 2000 & Windows 2000 Server (70-210, 70-215)
certifications.title: Microsoft Certified Professional -- Windows 2000 & Windows 2000 Server (70-210, 70-215)

projects.title: Launched Apparel and Media company Fire & Wheel
Nomadness Travel Tribe - Web & Merchandise Design
projects.description:
The Tribe, created by Evita Robinson and stemming from her travel series Nomad·ness TV, is an urban, travel, online social community of over 4,000 members. We're the edgy, under represented demo in the international travel industry, and we've formed our own Tribe. In the invitation-only platform, we share stories, advice, photos and conversation about our personal experiences around the world. We are the new age travel movement! Those without at least one passport stamp, need not apply. 

http://nomadnesstv.com/about-nomadness-travel-tribe/
